When there’s hope, anything is possible.
Every time we sell a Hyundai, a portion goes to Hyundai Hope On Wheels®
to help find a cure for childhood cancer. Over the last 20 years, Hyundai
Hope On Wheels has donated more than $145 million. Hope is our
greatest feature. And it comes standard on every Hyundai. For more
information, please visit HyundaiHopeOnWheels.org.
